name: Christmas Eve
source:
Christmas Eve is the story of a single father (MC) and his stepdaughter, Evelynne who are on a road trip just before Christmas. They end up making an unscheduled stop during a snowstorm and stay in a cabin for a few days. Romance blooms as the dad not only struggles with the changes in the relationship between him and his stepdaughter, but also finally starts to come to terms with his late wife's passing.

[From [url=https://jonesy75.itch.io/christmas-eve]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Christmas Eve》讲述单身父亲——也就是主角——与继女Evelynne的故事。圣诞节前，两人展开一场公路旅行，却因暴风雪临时停留，在小木屋住了几天。父亲一边面对自己与继女之间关系的变化，一边终于开始接受亡妻离世的事实，而爱情也在此时悄然萌芽。

[摘自[url=https://jonesy75.itch.io/christmas-eve]Itch.io[/url]]
